patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Instantly and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than RocketReach's shape. Choose RocketReach only if your buying job matches “B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights ” rather than Instantly's shape. Workflow advantage: Instantly leans sales-engagement; RocketReach leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom.; RocketReach is B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights with prospecting automations..
- Workflow coverage skew: Instantly-leaning sales-engagement vs RocketReach-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; RocketReach — Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager..

Limitations — Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases; RocketReach: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager.; Essentials is email-only; mobile/direct phones require Pro+..

Poor-fit cases: Instantly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core · RocketReach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager. · Avoid Instantly if you actually need RocketReach's motion (B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company)
